001: Hello, I would like to renew my ID card.
Hello, ma'am. Did you book an appointment online?
Yes, I have an appointment at ten thirty.
Perfect. I'll check your file. Do you have your old card?
Yes, here it is, with my photo and my proof of address.
Thank you, everything is in order. You'll be able to pick it up in three weeks.
002: Hello, I'm here to report a change of address.
Very well. Do you have a recent proof of address?
Yes, I have an electricity bill in my new name.
Perfect. I'll update your file right away.
Do I need to notify other services myself?
Yes, you'll need to contact social security and the bank separately.
003: Hello, I'd like to request a copy of a birth certificate.
Hello. For yourself or for a family member?
For myself, I need it for my marriage file.
Alright. You can request it directly on the town hall's website.
Oh, it's possible online? That's simpler.
Yes, and you'll receive it by mail within eight days.
004: Hello, I'm here to renew my passport.
Hello. Did you fill out the online form beforehand?
Yes, I received a file number. Here it is.
Thank you. I'll take your fingerprints and your photo.
Alright. Will the passport be ready before my trip?
Count on about four weeks, that's the usual processing time.
005: Hello, I'd like to register on the electoral rolls.
Hello. Are you already registered in another town?
No, this is my first registration here.
Very well. I'll fill out the form with you. Your civil status?
Camille Dubois, born on March fifteenth, nineteen ninety.
Perfect. You'll receive your voter card by mail before the elections.
006: Hello, I need a certificate of non-pledge for my car.
Hello. You can download it directly from the agency's website.
Really? I thought I had to come here.
No, it's online, it's faster. Do you have your license plate number?
Yes, I have it on my registration document. I'll try that.
If you have any trouble, come back and see us, we'll help you.
007: Hello, I'm here to apply for a grant for my studies.
Hello. Have you already put together your student social file?
Yes, I filled everything out online, but they're asking me for a document.
What document is it? Your parents' income?
You need to attach it on the portal before the end of the month.
008: Hello, I'd like to get a registration document for my new vehicle.
Hello. Do you have the seller's transfer certificate?
Yes, I have it here, along with the technical inspection and my ID.
Perfect. I'll submit the request online for you.
How long will it take to receive the registration document?
In general, you'll receive it at your home within a week.
009: Hello, I'm here about a problem with my health insurance card.
It doesn't work at the pharmacy anymore; they say it's deactivated.
I see. Have you had a change in your situation recently? A new address?
That's why. You need to update your file with social security.
010: Hello, I'd like to get a duplicate of my driver's license.
Hello. Did you report the loss online on the agency's website?
Yes, I did the pre-declaration and I received a number.
Very well. I'll check your file and take an ID photo.
Do I have to pay anything today?
No, the payment is made online when the file is validated.
